topic: How to help your teen price their first paid gig
caption:
Most teens underprice themselves out of confidence, not money.

Help your teen pick ONE service this week and look up what neighbors charge on Nextdoor or Facebook Marketplace.

A fair, specific price like $15 to mow a small yard gets more yeses than a vague 'I'll do it for whatever.'

Give them a head start → hustleup.us

copy.headline: Help Your Teen Price Their First Gig Right
copy.body: Have your teen pick one service, then research 3 local competitors. A teen charging $15/hr for lawn care or dog walking is realistic, credible, and easy to say yes to.
